name: inspect_scene
description: Inspect committed editor state, including an active manipulation preview (Move, Rotate or Scale), document origin, bounded canonical curve IDs/names/class/counts/domain, retained-source counts and read-only reason, pending human edits and source-appearance readiness. A node's read-only `transform_attributes` (rotate order, rotate axis in degrees, shear, pivot translations and `non_default`) reports transform extras and is present only when at least one is non-default. Curve draw_available means at least one visible instance prepared as draw geometry; it does not claim GPU health or framebuffer success. `status_message` mirrors the native status line text (null when empty, capped at 512 characters, a fixed notice instead of file-error text that can carry a local path). `camera` reports the pose: target, eye, distance, yaw/pitch in degrees, vertical field of view at the current viewport aspect and clip planes. No CV arrays or script bodies are exposed

name: set_active_tool
description: Select the native Select, Move, Rotate or Scale tool; unsupported tools are not exposed

name: set_tool_space
description: Set the Axis Orientation (object or world) of the Rotate or Scale tool settings, the same setting as the native Tool Settings selector; read it from inspect_scene manipulation.rotate_space and scale_space. Does not change the active tool

SpaceInput.description: Rotate and Scale work in the node's own axes (`object`) or the world axes (`world`).

inputSchema.description: Sets the Axis Orientation the Rotate or Scale tool settings use for the next manipulation.
inputSchema.title: ToolSpaceArgs

name: set_tool_handle
description: Set the persistent Rotate axis (x, y, z) or Scale handle (x, y, z, uniform) that the native Tool Settings selectors use for numeric entry; read them from inspect_scene manipulation.rotate_axis and scale_handle. begin_manipulation always names its own axis or handle and ignores this setting. Does not change the active tool or space

inputSchema.description:
`tool` selects which persistent selection is set: the Rotate axis or the Scale handle. Each
takes its own field and nothing else.
inputSchema.title: ToolHandleArgs

name: set_manipulator_size
description: Set the global size of the Move, Rotate and Scale manipulators, the same setting as the native + and - keys, from 0.1 to 10.0 (default 1.0); a value set here is rounded to three decimals, so 2.5555 reads back as 2.556. The keys step on the 1.25^k grid (k from -10 to 10, about 0.107 to 9.313) and store the exact grid value, so after a key step inspect_scene may report more decimals (for example 1.5625); a step from an off-grid value moves to the next grid value in that direction that changes the three-decimal value. Session-only: it never dirties the scene or enters undo history. Read it from inspect_scene manipulation.manipulator_size. Below 0.5 the drawn manipulator stops shrinking. Does not change the active tool

inputSchema.description: Sets the global manipulator size. The value is rounded to three decimals.

size.description: Between 0.1 and 10.0 inclusive; 2.5555 is stored and read back as 2.556.

inputSchema.title: ManipulatorSizeArgs

name: begin_manipulation
description: Begin one remote-owned Move (World axis), Rotate or Scale (Object or World space) of the exact selected transform instance. Numeric manipulation may begin while any tool is active; this does not change tools

SpaceInput.description: Rotate and Scale work in the node's own axes (`object`) or the world axes (`world`).

inputSchema.description:
`kind` selects the manipulation; each kind takes its own handle fields and nothing else. Move
works along World axes only and takes no `space`.
inputSchema.title: BeginManipulationArgs

name: update_manipulation
description: Preview an absolute value from begin: distance in the scene linear unit for Move, angle in the scene angular unit for Rotate, a unitless factor greater than zero for Scale. Units are echoed in inspection.manipulation.units. Matching scene token and remote-owned manipulation ID are required; a parameter of the wrong kind is a typed error

inputSchema.description: Exactly one of distance (Move), angle (Rotate) or factor (Scale), matching the kind of the manipulation; any other is a typed manipulation_kind_mismatch error

distance.description: Absolute Move distance from begin along the World axis, in the scene linear unit (inspection units.distance)

angle.description: Absolute Rotate angle from begin about the axis, in the scene angular unit (inspection units.angle)

factor.description: Absolute Scale factor from begin, unitless and greater than zero

inputSchema.title: UpdateManipulationArgs

name: finish_manipulation
description: Commit one undoable Move, Rotate or Scale edit or cancel to the exact begin authoring state. Only the matching remote-owned manipulation ID may finish

name: create_primitive
description: Create a cube, plane, sphere, cylinder or cone in the live editor. Optional options set sizes, subdivisions and axis (x, y or z) for that primitive; omitted fields use the defaults, and fields of other primitives are rejected. Options are validated against a 20,000-face budget per primitive; larger subdivisions are refused with invalid_params

name: select_node
description: Select an object using an optional full transform instance_path; ambiguous objects require a path. Null node_id clears selection without a path

name: set_selection_mode
description: Set Object, Face, Vertex, Edge or Hierarchy (Root sub-mask only) selection mode without editing the scene; a valid remembered face, vertex or edge stays inactive outside its own mode

name: select_face
description: Select a complete canonical face target in Face mode, or clear it with null; explicit targets need not be visible and select their owning instance

name: select_vertex
description: Select a complete canonical vertex target in Vertex mode, or clear it with null; explicit targets need not be visible and select their owning instance

name: select_edge
description: Select a complete canonical edge target in Edge mode, or clear it with null; explicit targets need not be visible and select their owning instance

name: rename_node
description: Rename an existing object

name: set_transform
description: Set f64 translation in declared scene units, rotation in XYZ degrees, and scale

name: edit_node
description: Edit optional name and individual f64 channels in one undo entry. Omitted arrays and null components are untouched; translation uses declared scene units and supplied rotations use degrees. Does not change selection

name: extrude_face
description: Extrude one current canonical quad along its local normal by distance in declared scene units. Requires node, shape and full root-to-shape path; shared-shape edits affect every instance. Zero distance changes topology; imported structural edits remain unsupported

name: set_material_diffuse
description: Edit the checked saved Phong diffuse scalar for an exact shape through shared undo history. Requires complete shared-shader users; affects all those shapes. Values are finite and nonnegative, may exceed one, and do not enable rendered materials

name: create_session_material
description: Create a session-only lambert material (not saved; Untitled scenes only, sourced and Maya ASCII scenes refuse) with a linear RGB colour, as its own undo step. Replies with its material_id. Material ids are decimal table indices valid only at the current history position: undo or redo can free and reuse them, so never cache one across edits

name: assign_session_material
description: Assign a session material to a whole authored shape; every instance of the shape changes. Give material_id (existing) or color (creates a lambert in the same undo step). Replies with the material_id, or unchanged. Not saved; sourced and Maya ASCII scenes refuse. Material ids are decimal table indices valid only at the current history position: undo or redo can free and reuse them, so never cache one across edits

color.description: Creates a new lambert with this colour in the same undo step. Give this or `material_id`.

material_id.description: An existing material id from inspection or a create reply. Give this or `color`.

name: set_session_material_color
description: Set the linear RGB colour of a session material created in this session; the initial material 0 is locked. Not saved; unrelated to the saved Phong set_material_diffuse. Material ids are decimal table indices valid only at the current history position: undo or redo can free and reuse them, so never cache one across edits

name: delete_node
description: Delete an object through editor undo history; refused in Face, Vertex or Edge selection mode

name: undo
description: Undo the last editor authoring operation

name: redo
description: Redo the last undone authoring operation

name: frame_selected
description: Frame the selected object using the live camera

name: frame_all
description: Frame every mesh and curve in the scene using the live camera; an empty scene returns nothing_to_frame. Session-only; does not edit the scene or the selection

name: set_grid_visibility
description: Set the current viewport's grid visibility explicitly. Session-only and idempotent; does not edit the scene or report GPU health

name: set_shading_mode
description: Set the current viewport's shading mode explicitly to wireframe or smooth_shade_all. Session-only and idempotent; does not edit the scene, change picking or report GPU health

ShadingMode.description: Session-only viewport shading, like grid visibility; never saved or dirtying.

name: orbit_camera
description: Orbit the live camera by [yaw, pitch] radians; pitch clamps near the poles

name: set_camera_pose
description: Set the live camera to an absolute pose: target [x, y, z], distance, yaw_degrees and pitch_degrees, the values inspect_scene reports, so a read pose restores exactly. Yaw wraps; pitch beyond about ±89.94 degrees is rejected. The field of view and clip planes are untouched; a distance below near_clip puts the target closer to the eye than the near plane (between the eye and the plane), so it is clipped and not pickable. Session-only; does not edit the scene

name: pan_camera
description: Translate the live camera target by [right, up] camera-plane world units

name: dolly_camera
description: Multiply live camera distance by a positive finite factor; below one moves closer

name: set_sidebar_panel_visibility
description: Set one sidebar panel's visibility explicitly. Session-only and idempotent; does not edit the scene. The dock shows one panel: showing attribute_editor hides channel_box and the reverse

name: select_attribute_editor_tab
description: Select the Attribute Editor tab for the selected node: transform, a direct shape, or the material of a direct shape; only the first 16 direct shapes have tabs. Session-only and idempotent; does not edit the scene. Refused unless attribute_editor is the active sidebar panel, and refused when the tab does not resolve for the current selection or names a shape beyond the 16th

id.description: Decimal id: the selected node for `transform`, a direct shape for `shape` and `material`.

name: open_scene
description: Open a Maya binary .mb, supported read-only static cubic Maya ASCII .ma, or legacy .aztec scene from a local UTF-8 path (1 to 4096 bytes, no NUL). ASCII scripts stay inert; unsupported commands/effects refuse the whole candidate. Dirty documents require confirmation. ASCII native writing is unavailable

name: save_scene
description: Save the active supported Maya binary document, or reconcile an earlier uncertain installation without another write

name: save_scene_as
description: Save a supported Maya binary scene to a fresh .mb path without overwriting; an uncertain prior save is reconciled instead

name: new_scene
description: Request a new empty document; dirty documents require explicit confirmation using the returned pending_action_id

name: resolve_file_action
description: Cancel, discard or save before the exact pending file action using its UUID and current scene token; source-changed Open requires Cancel and reopening

name: request_close
description: Request native window closure; dirty documents require explicit confirmation, and approved remote closure waits for its successful reply to be flushed
